lines.label: start
lines.en: [b]Confession Room[/b] is for adults. Every character in it is an adult, and is written as one.

lines.label: start
lines.en: It contains explicit sexual content, and a homicide investigation told without flinching. If that is not what you came for, close it here. No hard feelings, and no argument.

lines.label: start
lines.en: The illustrations in this game were made with AI image generation, directed, culled and retouched by hand. The writing and the case are human-written.

lines.label: start
lines.en: Reyes. Paloma nightclub, back office. One down, three keys, and the captain wants it closed before the morning shift reads about it.

lines.label: start
lines.en: You have twelve questions. Not by rule. By the hour the captain gets in.

lines.en: [b][CASE['title']][/b]

lines.label: case_open
lines.en: Three doors off one corridor, and behind each of them somebody who has had all night to decide what kind of person they are going to be for you.

lines.label: case_open
lines.en: Nobody has asked for a lawyer. That tells you something, and not enough.

lines.label: evidence_locker
lines.en: Forensics left one photograph in the tray with a sticker over half of it — the way they do when the file is going to be read by people who talk.

lines.label: evidence_locker
lines.en: Look at the uncensored plate?

lines.label: evidence_locker
lines.en: A shoe. Left foot, under the bottom rack of a walk-in cooler, with a yellow marker beside it.

lines.label: evidence_locker
lines.en: Marek was found in the office. He did not get there by himself.

lines.label: evidence_locker
lines.en: So whoever moved him stood in that cold long enough to mind it.

lines.label: evidence_locker
lines.en: A utility sink, deep enough to lose an arm in, still full. The water in it is clear. The water in the loading bay is not.

lines.label: evidence_locker
lines.en: Iris drowned. The file says the bay. The bay is rain and diesel, and she had neither in her.

lines.label: evidence_locker
lines.en: So she drowned indoors and somebody drove her outside afterwards.

lines.label: evidence_locker
lines.en: A floor safe, open. The cash still banded and still in it. The inner drawer pulled out and empty, and a clean rectangle in the dust where something used to sit.

lines.label: evidence_locker
lines.en: The file says nothing was missing. The file was counting money.

lines.label: evidence_locker
lines.en: Something the size of a book. Worth more than everything stacked under it.

lines.label: evidence_locker
lines.en: Half a photograph and a sticker. Whatever forensics wanted you to see, you will have to take out of a person instead.
